summary: The participation mirror and the Relevance Gate's review channel reach Discord again: a shadow channel is now configured, and validated, as "<guild_id>/<channel_id>".
details: A shadow channel written as a bare Discord channel id addressed /channels//messages, which Discord refuses with HTTP 405 — so every Relevance Gate GO verdict was dropped instead of posted for review. Both config sections documented and accepted the bare form, so a config that followed the documentation could not work.

The config schema now refuses a Discord shadow_channel that names no channel, at load, for both [participation] and [relevance_gate]. The Discord adapter refuses such a target before the request as well.
A shadow post that fails is reported by cause: a guard refusal and a send the platform rejected are no longer both logged as "REFUSED by a guard".

A dream adaptor granted a home room in a workspace that declares none is now logged once per workspace and counted on every pass (nora_dream_home_room_missing_total), instead of raising an identical error every dream.
limitations: Only Discord shadow channels are shape-checked; a Signal conversation id is one opaque string with no second half to require.
